title: Pattern 10: Private AlloyDB PostgreSQL ScaNN RAG Deployment
description: Schema for Pattern 10 Private AlloyDB pgvector & ScaNN RAG deployment with dedicated VPC, Serverless VPC Access connector, restricted IAM invokers, and optional Cloud Run serving service.

project_id.description: GCP Project ID hosting AlloyDB resources.

use_existing_network.description: Whether to use an existing VPC network instead of creating a new one.

network_name.description: Name of the custom VPC network to create if use_existing_network is false.

existing_network_name.description: VPC network ID or self link if use_existing_network is true.

existing_connector_id.description: Existing Serverless VPC Access connector ID if use_existing_network is true.

cluster_id.description: Unique ID for the AlloyDB cluster.

initial_user_password.description: Password for the initial postgres administrative user.

instance_id.description: Instance ID for primary AlloyDB instance.

cpu_count.description: Number of vCPUs for primary instance (2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128).

database_flags.description: PostgreSQL configuration flags for vector indexing and ScaNN.

allowed_invoker_members.description: List of IAM members permitted to connect to AlloyDB cluster.

enable_cloud_run.description: Enable optional Cloud Run RAG retrieval / generation serving service.

container_image.description: Container image URL deployed to Cloud Run.

labels.description: Resource labels attached to all resources.
